reference_sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) AS order_eur
  FROM order_lines
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT AVG(order_eur) AS avg_order_eur
FROM order_totals
alternatives: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_order_eur FROM order_lines
WITH order_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(net_revenue_eur) AS order_eur FROM sales GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(order_eur) / COUNT(*) AS avg_order_eur FROM order_totals

other_way.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity * unit_price_eur - line_discount_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_order_eur FROM order_lines
other_way.tradeoff: Dividing the total by the number of different orders takes one step, but the named step lets you check each order's value first.
